'''The Pandemonium''' is a collection of ships connected to an island off the eastern coast of [[Karamja]]. It contains a [[The Pandemonium Dungeon|dungeon]], an eponymous pub, a bank crab, and a dock. It is first accessed during the [[Pandemonium]] quest and serves as a starting place to begin training [[Sailing]].

==History==
The Pandemonium was originally founded by [['Squawking' Steve Beanie]] after he crashed his ship, the Pandemonium, during his first proper voyage.{{CiteNPC|npc=Fiora|quote=Indeed there is. Steve fancied himself a pirate, but on his first proper voyage he managed to crash his ship, the Pandemonium, right here. [He crashed? How?] He claims it was an unavoidable accident caused by the Storm Tempor, but I heard it was actually because he got distracted by a large flock of angry parrots.|loc=|notes=|name=}} He proceeded to open a bar in the crashed ship, and the location became a place where the laws of the mainland kingdoms do not apply and all are welcome as long as they respect their fellow patrons.{{CiteNPC|npc='Squawking' Steve Beanie|quote=Avast! The mainland kingdoms have no authority here. Their laws do not apply. Instead, we just have our one rule that keeps the Pandemonium afloat: Never disrespect your fellow patron. We don't care who you are. Indeed, pirates and customs officers can enjoy a drink here, side by side. Savvy?|loc=|notes=|name=}} Indeed, both pirates and [[Customs and Excise Office]]rs can be seen drinking side by side at Steve's bar.

==Transportation==
All methods of travelling to the Pandemonium require progressing the [[Pandemonium]] quest to the point where you visit the island.

* Teleport with the [[sailors' amulet]] (requires 1 law rune and 10 water runes per 10 charges)
* Teleport with a [[Sailing cape]], either directly, or to a docked boat with a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|Greater Teleport Focus]]
* Sail with your ship and [[Docking point|dock]] at the island
* [[Teleport to Boat]] (if it's at the island, requiring a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|Greater Teleport Focus]] and either 67 [[Magic]] or a [[teleport to boat (tablet)|tablet]])
* Charter [[Captain Tobias]]' ship from [[Port Sarim]] (requires 30 [[coins]], or [[Ring of Charos(a)]])
* Charter [[Customs officer]]'s ship from [[Musa Point]] (requires 30 coins - lowered to 15 coins, if wearing [[Karamja gloves]], or free if wearing [[Ring of Charos(a)]])
* Taking a [[charter ship]] from any charter location except Port Sarim or Musa Point

==Features==
Pandemonium has a variety of activities and hot-spots catered towards players starting out with the Sailing skill and other low-level skills.

===Pandemonium Port===
[[File:Pandemonium_Crab_Bank.png|thumb|right|The crab bank chest at Pandemonium]]
As the starting island for people looking to train the Sailing skill, Pandemonium has a port with all corresponding Sailing activities available and serves as a starter hub for the skill.

Connected to the port and built atop the water is the [[The_Pandemonium_(Pub)|Pandemonium Pub]] run by [['Squawking'_Steve_Beanie|Squawking' Steve Beanie]]. Here, players can also start the quest [[Prying Times]]. Just north of the pub is a [[Henderson's_Catch_of_the_Day|fishing shop]] run by [[Henderson]] that sells the standard supplies of fishing tools and raw fish up to bass.

===Pandemonium Island===
The island gives access to certain skilling nodes and a bank that can aid players in collecting certain resources for training Sailing.
* [[Cooking]] range
* [[Hunter]] training - [[red crab]]s to [[crab trapping|trap]]
* [[Fishing_spot_(small_net,_bait)|Small net / Bait fishing]] 
* [[Pandemonium Cave|The Pandemonium Cave]] with several mining nodes, low level monsters and a permanent [[Fire|fire]].

==Charter ship==
*After completing the [[Cabin Fever]] quest, the price between two locations, as displayed below, will halve the charter costs to 50%.
*The [[Ring of Charos(a)]] also halves the charter costs to 50%.
**These cost reductions can be combined to reduce the costs to 25%.
*Keep in mind the variance between destination fares. Similar to a layover, chartering to another destination first or using a non-charter ship like from [[Port Sarim]] to [[Musa Point]] can net significant savings. For example, the 2,900 coins cost to travel from [[Port Phasmatys]] to [[Brimhaven]] can be reduced by first chartering to Musa Point for 1,100 coins, then to Brimhaven for 200 coins.
**The only exception to this is [[Port Tyras]], which has the same fare to and from every other port.
